H⁺ konsentratsiyasi tufayli seziladi.
Kuçi H⁺ konsentratsiyasining logarifmiga proporsional.
Ionlangan tuzlar, asosan Na⁺ tufayli seziladi.

Ba’zi tuzlar qöşimça ta’m ham beradi.
**Şirin:** bitta kimyoviy sinf bilan boğliq emas.

Uni beruvçi moddalar: şakarlar, glikollar, spirtlar, aldegidlar, ketonlar, amidlar, efirlar, ba’zi aminokislotalar, kiçik oqsillar, sulfokislotalar, galogenlangan kislotalar, qörğoşin va berilliy tuzlari.

Kiçik radikal qöşilişi şirinni aççiqqa aylantirişi mumkin.

Asosiy sinflari: azotli uzun zanjirli moddalar va **alkaloidlar** (xinin, kofein, strixnin, nikotin).
Saxarin şirin, lekin aççiq “keyingi ta’m” qoldiradi. Yuqori konsentratsiyali tuzlar ham aççiq bölişi mumkin.
Kuçli aççiq ta’m ovqatni rad etişga olib keladi. Bu himoya vazifasi: zaharli ösimliklar alkaloidlari deyarli hammasi aççiq.
**Umami** (“mazali”):
L-glutamat ta’mi; göşt ekstrakti va yetilgan pişloqda uçraydi.
Oqsil iste’molini rağbatlantiradi.
**Aççiq ta’m eng sezgir** va zaharlardan himoya qiladi.

Ta’m moddasi hujayrani **depolyarizatsiya** qiladi.
Kattaligi konsentratsiya logarifmiga proporsional.

Ta’m bir daqiqa içida deyarli töliq adaptatsiyalanadi.

Adrenalektomiyadan keyin tuzi kamaygan hayvon şör suvni tanlaydi va tuz yetişmasligidan ölimning oldini oladi.
Insulin yuborilib gipoglikemiya çaqirilgan hayvon eng şirin ovqatni tanlaydi.
Paratireoidektomiyadan keyin kalsiyi kamaygan hayvon CaCl₂ li suvni tanlaydi.
Hayotda: çöldagi “tuz yalaş” joylari hayvonlarni jalb qiladi.
**Asosan MNS mexanizmi**, garçi retseptorlar zarur moddaga sezgirlaşişi mumkin.
**Ta’m aversiyasi:** ovqatdan keyin kasal bölgan odam yoki hayvon şu ovqatdan nafratlanadi. Bu oldingi tajribaning rolini körsatadi.

**Maydoni:** ~5 sm².
**Hid hujayralari:**
Bipolyar nerv hujayralari, MNS dan kelib çiqqan; ~100 million ta.
Sustentakulyar hujayralar orasida joylaşgan.
Şilliq tomondagi uçida börtma bor, undan 4–25 ta **hid kiprigi** çiqadi (0.3 µm, 200 µm gaça uzun). Kiprikçalar şilliq içida ziç gilam hosil qiladi.
**Bowman bezlari:** şilliq işlab çiqaradi.
Hidli modda şilliqqa diffuziyalanadi va kiprikdagi retseptor oqsiliga boğlanadi. Retseptor membranani 7 marta kesib ötadi.

α subbirlik **adenilil siklaza**ni faollaştiradi.
Siklaza köp ATP ni **cAMP** ga aylantiradi.
cAMP Na⁺ kanallarini oçadi, köp Na⁺ kiradi va hujayra depolyarizatsiyalanadi. AP hid nervi orqali MNS ga boradi.

**Uçuvçanlik:** modda nafas bilan burunga kirişi kerak.
**Suvda biroz eruvçanlik:** şilliqdan ötişi uçun.
**Yoğda biroz eruvçanlik:** kiprik lipidlaridan ötişi uçun foydali.

**Hid ta’sirida:** −30 mV yoki undan ham kam manfiy böladi, AP 20–30/s.
**Stimul kuçi bilan boğliqlik:** impuls çastotasi stimul kuçining logarifmiga proporsional.
**Retseptorlar:** ~1 s da ~50% adaptatsiyalanadi, keyin juda sekin.
**Idrok:** kuçli hidli muhitda ~1 daqiqada deyarli töliq yöqoladi, demak asosan **markaziy**.
**Mexanizm:** miyadan hid trakti orqali köp **sentrifugal tolalar** piyozçadagi inhibitor **granulyar hujayralar**ga boradi. Ular kuçli teskari inhibitsiya beradi.
**Eski psixologik tasnif:** kamforasimon, muşkli, gulli, yalpizli, efirli, ötkir, çirigan. Bu haqiqiy birlamçilar emas.
**Hozirgi tuşunça:**
Genetik dalillarga köra kamida **100** birlamçi hid bor, ba’zi tadqiqotlarga köra **1000** gaça retseptor turi.
Taqqoslaş uçun: rang 3 ta, ta’m 5 ta.
Alohida moddalarga “hid körligi” 50 dan ortiq modda uçun aniqlangan. Har biri tegişli retseptor oqsilining yöqligi bilan izohlanadi.
**Affektiv tabiati:**
Hid ta’mdan ham köra yoqimli yoki yoqimsiz böladi, ovqat tanlaşda ehtimol muhimroq.
Ilgari zarar bergan ovqat hididan köngil ayniydi.
Atir emotsiyani kuçli qözğatadi; ba’zi hayvonlarda hid jinsiy mayl qözğatuvçisi.
**Bösağa:** **metilmerkaptan** 1 ml havoda 1/25 trillion gramm bölganda ham seziladi. Gaz sizişini aniqlaş uçun tabiiy gazga qöşiladi.
**Gradatsiya:**
Bösağadan atigi 10–50 marta yuqori konsentratsiya maksimal intensivlik beradi.
Taqqoslaş uçun: közda 500 000:1, quloqda 1 trillion:1.
Sababi: hid miqdordan köra “bor yoki yöq”ni aniqlaşga yönaltirilgan.
**Evolyutsion ahamiyati:** hid tuzilmalari miyaning eng qadimgi qismlaridan. Ular keyinçalik **limbik tizim**ga aylangan (ç59).

Etmoid suyakning ğalvirsimon plastinkasi ustida joylaşgan. Teşiklar orqali kalta aksonlar ötadi.
Bulb va trakt (I kranial nerv) aslida miyaning oldinga ösib çiqqan qismi.
**Glomerulalar:**
Har piyozçada bir neça ming.
Har biriga ~25 000 akson keladi, ~25 **mitral** va ~60 **tufted** hujayra dendriti boradi.
Mitral va tufted hujayralar aksonlari hid traktini hosil qiladi.
Turli glomerulalar turli hidlarga javob berişi mumkin; hid tahlilining kaliti şu bölişi mumkin.
**Trakt bölinişi:** mezensefalon va katta miya oldingi çegarasida ikkiga bölinadi (Fig 54-5).
**Medial hid sohasi (eng qadimiy tizim):**
Gipotalamus oldida joylaşgan, asosan **septal yadrolar**dan iborat. Gipotalamus va limbik tizimga signal beradi; asosiy xulq-atvor bilan boğliq.
Lateral sohalar olib taşlansa ham asosiy reflekslar (lab yalaş, sölak, ovqatlaniş reaksiyalari, emotsional mayllar) saqlanadi. Murakkab şartli reflekslar esa yöqoladi.
**Lateral hid sohasi (kamroq qadimiy tizim):**
Prepiriform va piriform pöstloq hamda amigdalaning pöstloq qismidan iborat.
Limbik tizimga, ayniqsa **gippokamp**ga boradi. Tajribaga köra ovqatni yoqtiriş yoki yoqtirmaslikni örganişda muhim. Masalan, qusiş çaqirgan ovqatga mutlaq nafrat hosil böladi.
Çakka bölagi oldingi-medial qismidagi **paleokorteks**ga ham boradi. Bu sezgi signali **talamusni çetlab** töğridan-töğri pöstloqqa boradigan yagona joy.

Talamusning **dorsomedial yadrosi** orqali **orbitofrontal pöstloq**ning lateroposterior kvadrantiga boradi.
Hidni ongli tahlil qiladi (maymunlardagi tadqiqotlar).
**Xulosa:**
Qadimiy tizim asosiy reflekslarni boşqaradi.
Kamroq qadimiy tizim ovqat iste’moli va zaharli ovqatdan qoçişni avtomatik, qisman örganilgan yöl bilan boşqaradi.
Yangi tizim ongli idrok va tahlilni ta’minlaydi.

Miyadan piyozçadagi **granulyar hujayralar**ga tolalar boradi. Ular mitral va tufted hujayralarni tormozlaydi.
Hidlarni bir-biridan farqlaşni ötkirlaştirişi mumkin.

full.text: The senses of taste and smell allow us to separate undesir able or even lethal foods from those that are pleasant to eat and nutritious. They also elicit physiological responses involved in the digestion and utilization of foods. The sense of smell allows animals to recognize the proximity of other animals or even individual animals. Finally, both senses are strongly tied to primitive emotional and behav ioral functions of our nervous systems. In this chapter, we discuss how taste and smell stimuli are detected and how they are encoded in neural signals transmitted to the brain.
SENSE OF TASTE

Taste is mainly a function of the _taste buds_ in the mouth, but it is common experience that one’s sense of smell also contributes strongly to taste perception. In addition, the texture of food, as detected by tactual senses of the mouth, and the presence of substances in the food that stimulate pain endings, such as pepper, greatly alter the taste experience. The importance of taste lies in the fact that it allows a person to select food in accord with desires and often in accord with the body tissues’ metabolic need for specific substances.
PRIMARY TASTE SENSATIONS

The identities of the many specific chemicals that excite different taste receptors are not all known. For practi cal analysis, the _primary sensations of taste_ have been grouped into five general categories—_sour, salty, sweet, bitter_, and “_umami_.”

A person can perceive hundreds of different tastes. They are all thought to be combinations of the elemen tary taste sensations, just as all the colors we can see are combinations of the three primary colors, as described in Chapter 51.

The sour taste is caused by acids—that is, by the hydrogen ion concentration—and the intensity of this taste sensation is approximately proportional to the _logarithm of the hydrogen ion concentration_ (i.e., the more acidic the food, the stronger the sour sensation be comes).

The salty taste is elicited by ionized salts, mainly by the sodium ion concentration. The quality of the taste varies somewhat from one salt to another be cause some salts elicit other taste sensations in addition to saltiness. The cations of the salts, especially sodium cations, are mainly responsible for the salty taste, but the anions also contribute to a lesser extent.

The sweet taste is not caused by any single class of chemicals. Some of the types of chemicals that cause this taste include sugars, glycols, alcohols, alde hydes, ketones, amides, esters, some amino acids, some small proteins, sulfonic acids, halogenated acids, and in organic salts of lead and beryllium. Note specifically that most of the substances that cause a sweet taste are organic chemicals. It is especially interesting that slight changes in the chemical structure, such as the addition of a simple radical, can often change the substance from sweet to bit ter.

The bitter taste, like the sweet taste, is not caused by any single type of chemical agent. Here again, the substances that give the bitter taste are almost entirely organic substances. Two particular classes of substances are especially likely to cause bitter taste sensations: (1) long-chain organic substances that contain nitrogen; and (2) alkaloids. The alkaloids include many of the drugs used in medicines, such as quinine, caffeine, strychnine, and nicotine.

Some substances that initially taste sweet have a bitter aftertaste. This characteristic is true of saccharin, which makes this substance objectionable to some people. High concentrations of salts may also result in a bitter taste.

The bitter taste, when it occurs in high intensity, usu ally causes the person or animal to reject the food. This reaction is undoubtedly an important function of the bit ter taste sensation because many deadly toxins found in poisonous plants are alkaloids, and virtually all these alka loids cause an intensely bitter taste, usually followed by rejection of the food.

_Umami,_ a Japanese word meaning “deli cious,” designates a pleasant taste sensation that is qualita tively different from sour, salty, sweet, or bitter. Umami is the dominant taste of food containing _l-glutamate,_ such as meat extracts and aging cheese. The pleasurable sensa tion of umami taste is thought to be important for nutri tion by promoting ingestion of proteins.
THRESHOLD FOR TASTE

The molar threshold for stimulation of the sour taste by hydrochloric acid averages 0.0009 M, for stimulation of the salty taste by sodium chloride, 0.01 M, for the sweet taste by sucrose, 0.01 M, and for the bitter taste by qui nine, 0.000008 M. Note especially that the bitter taste sense is much more sensitive than all the others, which provides an important protective function against many dangerous toxins in food.

**Table 54-1** lists the relative taste indices (the reciprocals of the taste thresholds) of different substances. In this table, the intensities of four of the primary sensations of taste are referred, respectively, to the intensities of the taste of hydrochloric acid, quinine, sucrose, and sodium chloride, each of which is arbitrarily chosen to have a taste index of 1.

Some people are taste blind for certain substances, especially for different types of thiourea com pounds. A substance used frequently by psychologists for demonstrating taste blindness is _phenylthiocarbamide_, for which about 15% to 30% of all people exhibit taste blindness; the exact percentage depends on the method of testing and the concentration of the substance.
TASTE BUDS AND THEIR FUNCTION

**Figure 54-1B** shows a taste bud, which has a diame ter of about 1⁄30 of a millimeter and a length of about 1⁄16 of a millimeter. The taste bud is composed of epithe lial cells; some are supporting cells called _sustentacular cells_ and others are called _taste cells_. There are about 100 taste cells in each taste bud. The taste cells are continually being replaced by mitotic division of surrounding epithe lial cells, so some taste cells are young cells. Others are mature cells that lie toward the center of the bud; these cells soon break up and dissolve. The average life span of each taste cell is estimated to be about 10 days, although there is considerable variation, with some taste cells being eliminated in only 2 days while others may survive for over 3 weeks.

The outer tips of the taste cells are arranged around a minute _taste pore_, shown in **Figure 54-1B**. From the tip of each taste cell, several _microvilli_, or _taste hairs_, protrude outward into the taste pore to approach the cavity of the mouth. These microvilli provide the receptor surface for taste.

Interwoven around the bodies of the taste cells is a branching terminal network of _taste nerve fibers_ that are stimulated by the taste receptor cells. Some of these fibers invaginate into folds of the taste cell membranes. Many vesicles form beneath the cell membrane near the fibers. These vesicles are believed to contain a neurotransmit ter substance that is released through the cell membrane to excite the nerve fiber endings in response to taste stimulation.

The taste buds are found on three types of papillae of the tongue, as follows (see **Figure 54-1A**): (1) a large number of taste buds are on the walls of the troughs that surround the _circumvallate papillae_, which form a V line on the surface of the pos terior tongue; (2) moderate numbers are on the _foliate papillae_ located in the folds along the lateral surfaces of the tongue; and (3) moderate numbers of taste buds are on the _fungiform papillae_ over the flat anterior sur face of the tongue. Additional taste buds are located on the palate, and a few are found on the tonsillar pillars, on the epiglottis, and even in the proximal esophagus. Adults have 3000 to 10,000 taste buds, and children have a few more. Beyond the age of 45 years, many taste buds degenerate, causing taste sensitivity to decrease in old age.

Microelectrode studies from single taste buds show that each taste bud usually _responds mostly to one of the five primary taste stimuli when the taste substance is in low concentration_. However, at high concentration, most buds can be excited by two or more of the primary taste stimu li, as well as by a few other taste stimuli that do not fit into the “primary” categories.

full.text: Mechanism of Stimulation of Taste Buds

The membrane of the taste cell, like that of most other sensory receptor cells, is negatively charged on the inside with respect to the outside. Appli cation of a taste substance to the taste hairs causes par tial loss of this negative potential—that is, the taste cell becomes _depolarized_. In most cases, the decrease in po tential, within a wide range, is approximately proportional to the logarithm of concentration of the stimulating sub stance. This _change in electrical potential_ in the taste cell is called the _receptor potential_ for taste.

The mechanism whereby most stimulating substances react with the taste villi to initiate the receptor potential is by binding of the taste chemical to a protein receptor molecule that lies on the outer surface of the taste recep tor cell, near to or protruding through a villus membrane. This action, in turn, opens ion channels, which allows positively charged sodium ions or hydrogen ions to enter and depolarize the normal negativity of the cell. Then, the taste chemical is gradually washed away from the taste villus by the saliva, which removes the stimulus.

The type of receptor protein in each taste villus deter mines the type of taste that will be perceived. For sodium ions and hydrogen ions, which elicit salty and sour taste sensations, respectively, the receptor proteins open spe cific ion channels, likely the epithelial sodium channel (ENaC), in the apical membranes of the taste cells, thereby activating the receptors. However, for the sweet and bit ter taste sensations, the portions of the G-protein coupled receptors that protrude through the apical membranes activate _second-messenger transmitter substances_ inside the taste cells; these second messengers cause intracellu lar chemical changes that elicit the taste signals.

Sweet-tasting compounds are detected by a combi nation of two closely related G-protein-coupled taste receptors, T1R2 and T1R3. The receptors responsible for umami taste is believed to be a complex of T1R1 and T1R3 proteins. Thus, T1R3 appears to function as a coreceptor for sweet and umami tastes.

Bitter taste is sensed by another family (T2R) of approximately 30 different G-protein coupled receptors. Individual bitter-sensing taste receptor cells express mul tiple T2Rs, each of which recognizes a unique set of bitter compounds. This pattern of receptor expression permits detection of a variety of bitter compounds through a sin gle type of taste receptor cell.

Sour taste, associated with acidic food or drink, is believed to be sensed by ion channels that are opened by hydrogen ions although the precise mechanisms are not fully understood. Recent studies suggest that an acidsensitive potassium channel (KIR2.1) and a hydrogen ion–selective ion channel (otopetrin 1) may mediate acid responses in taste receptor cells.

On first application of the taste stimulus, the rate of discharge of the nerve fibers from taste buds rises to a peak in a small fraction of a second but then adapts within the next few seconds back to a lower steady level as long as the taste stimulus remains. Thus, a strong immediate signal is transmitted by the taste nerve, and a weaker continuous signal is transmitted as long as the taste bud is exposed to the taste stimulus.
full.lead: Generation of Nerve Impulses by the Taste Bud.

full.text: TRANSMISSION OF TASTE SIGNALS INTO THE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM

**Figures 54-1** and **54-2** show the neuronal pathways for transmission of taste signals from the tongue and pharyn geal region into the central nervous system. Taste impulses from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue pass first into the _lingual nerve_, then through the _chorda tympani_ into the _facial nerve_, and finally into the _tractus solitarius_ in the brain stem. Taste sensations from the circumvallate papillae on the back of the tongue and from other pos terior regions of the mouth and throat are transmitted through the _glossopharyngeal nerve_ also into the tractus solitarius, but at a slightly more posterior level. Finally, a few taste signals are transmitted into the tractus solitarius from the base of the tongue and other parts of the pharyn geal region by way of the _vagus nerve_.

All taste fibers synapse in the posterior brain stem in the nuclei of the tractus solitarius. These nuclei send second-order neurons to a small area of the _ventral pos terior medial nucleus of the thalamus_, located slightly medial to the thalamic terminations of the facial regions of the dorsal column–medial lemniscal system. From the thalamus, third-order neurons are transmitted to the _lower tip of the postcentral gyrus in the parietal cerebral cortex_, where it curls _deep into the sylvian fissure_, and into the adjacent _opercular insular area_. This area lies slightly lateral, ventral, and rostral to the area for tongue tactile signals in cerebral somatic area I. From this description of the taste pathways, it is evident that they closely parallel the somatosensory pathways from the tongue.

From the tractus solitarius, many taste signals are transmitted within the brain stem itself directly into the _superior_ and _inferior salivatory nuclei_. These areas transmit signals to the submandibular, sublingual, and parotid glands to help control the secretion of saliva during the ingestion and digestion of food.
full.lead: Taste Reflexes Are Integrated in the Brain Stem.

full.text: Everyone is familiar with the fact that taste sensations adapt rapidly, often almost completely, within a minute or so of continuous stimula tion. Yet, from electrophysiological studies of taste nerve fibers, it is clear that adaptation of the taste buds usually accounts for no more than about half of this rapid taste adaptation. Therefore, the final extreme degree of adapta tion that occurs in the sensation of taste almost certainly occurs in the central nervous system, although the mech anisms are not known. This mechanism of adaptation is different from that of many other sensory systems, which adapt mainly at the receptors.
TASTE PREFERENCE AND CONTROL OF THE DIET

_Taste preference_ simply means that an animal will choose certain types of food in preference to others, and the animal automatically uses this preference to help con trol what it eats. Furthermore, its taste preferences often change in accord with the body’s need for certain specific substances.

The following experiments demonstrate this abil ity of animals to choose food in accord with the needs of their bodies. First, adrenalectomized, _salt-depleted_ animals automatically select drinking water with a high concentration of sodium chloride in preference to pure water, and the amount of sodium chloride in the water is often sufficient to supply the needs of the body and prevent death due to salt depletion. Second, an animal given injections of excessive amounts of insulin develops a depleted blood sugar level, and the animal automatically chooses the sweetest food from among many samples. Third, calcium-depleted, parathyroidectomized animals automatically choose drinking water with a high concen tration of calcium chloride.

The same phenomena are also observed in everyday life. For example, the “salt licks” of desert regions are known to attract animals from far and wide. Also, human beings reject food that has an unpleasant affective sensa tion, which in many cases protects our bodies from unde sirable substances.

The phenomenon of taste preference almost certainly results from some mechanism located in the central nervous system and not from a mechanism in the taste receptors, although the receptors often become sensitized in favor of a needed nutrient. An important reason for believing that taste preference is mainly a central nervous system phenomenon is that previous experience with unpleasant or pleasant tastes plays a major role in deter mining one’s taste preferences. For example, if a person becomes sick soon after eating a particular type of food, the person then generally develops a negative taste prefer ence, or _taste aversion_, for that particular food; the same effect can be demonstrated in lower animals.
SENSE OF SMELL

Smell is the least understood of our senses, partly because the sense of smell is a subjective phenomenon that cannot be studied with ease in lower animals. Another compli cating problem is that the sense of smell is poorly devel oped in human beings compared with the sense of smell in many other mammals.
OLFACTORY MEMBRANE

The olfactory membrane, the histology of which is shown in **Figure 54-3**, lies in the superior part of the nasal cav ity. Medially, the olfactory membrane folds downward along the surface of the superior septum; laterally, it folds over the superior turbinate and even over a small portion of the upper surface of the middle turbinate. The olfac tory membrane has a total surface area of about 5 square centimeters in humans.

The _olfactory cells_ (see **Figure 53-3**) are actually bipolar nerve cells derived originally from the central nervous system. There are about 100 million of these cells in the olfactory epithelium interspersed among _sus tentacular cells_, as shown in **Figure 54-3**. The mucosal end of the olfactory cell forms a knob from which 4 to 25 _olfactory hairs_ (also called _olfactory cilia_), measuring 0.3 micrometer in diameter and up to 200 micrometers in length, project into the mucus that coats the inner surface of the nasal cavity. These projecting olfactory cilia form a dense mat in the mucus, and it is these cilia that react to odors in the air and stimulate the olfactory cells, as dis cussed later. Spaced among the olfactory cells in the olfac tory membrane are many small _Bowman glands_ that se crete mucus onto the surface of the olfactory membrane.
full.lead: Olfactory Cells Are the Receptor Cells for Smell Sensation.

full.text: STIMULATION OF THE OLFACTORY CELLS

The portion of each olfactory cell that responds to the olfac tory chemical stimuli is the _olfactory cilia_. The odorant substance, on coming in contact with the olfactory mem brane surface, first diffuses into the mucus that covers the cilia and then it binds with _receptor proteins_ in the mem brane of each cilium (**Figure 54-4**). Each receptor protein is actually a long molecule that threads its way through the membrane about seven times, folding inward and outward.
full.lead: Mechanism of Excitation of the Olfactory Cells.

full.text: The odorant binds with the portion of the receptor protein that folds to the outside. The inside of the folding protein is coupled to a _G protein_, itself a combination of three subu nits. On excitation of the receptor protein, an _alpha_ subu nit breaks away from the G protein and activates _adenylyl cyclase_, which is attached to the inside of the ciliary mem brane near the receptor cell body. The activated cyclase, in turn, converts many molecules of intracellular _adeno sine triphosphate_ (ATP) into _cyclic adenosine monophos phate_ (cAMP). Finally, this cAMP activates another nearby membrane protein, a _gated sodium ion channel_, that opens its “gate” and allows large numbers of sodium ions to pour through the membrane into the receptor cell cytoplasm. The sodium ions increase the electrical potential in the positive direction inside the cell membrane, thus exciting the olfactory neuron and transmitting action potentials into the central nervous system via the _olfactory nerve_.

The importance of this mechanism for activating olfac tory nerves is that it greatly multiplies the excitatory effect of even the weakest odorant. To summarize: (1) activation of the receptor protein by the odorant substance activates the G-protein complex, which, in turn (2) activates mul tiple molecules of adenylyl cyclase inside the olfactory cell membrane, which (3) causes the formation of many times more molecules of cAMP, and finally, (4) the cAMP opens still many times more sodium ion channels. Therefore, even a minute concentration of a specific odorant initiates a cascading effect that opens extremely large numbers of sodium channels. This process accounts for the exquisite sensitivity of the olfactory neurons to even the slightest amount of odorant.

In addition to the basic chemical mechanism whereby the olfactory cells are stimulated, several physical factors affect the degree of stimulation. First, only volatile sub stances that can be sniffed into the nasal cavity can be smelled. Second, the stimulating substance must be at least slightly water-soluble so that it can pass through the mucus to reach the olfactory cilia. Third, it is helpful for the substance to be at least slightly lipid-soluble, presum ably because lipid constituents of the cilium are a weak barrier to non–lipid-soluble odorants.

The membrane potential inside unstim ulated olfactory cells, as measured by microelectrodes, averages about −55 millivolts. At this potential, most of the cells generate continuous action potentials at a very slow rate, varying from once every 20 seconds up to two or three per second.
full.lead: Membrane Potentials and Action Potentials in Olfactory Cells.

full.text: Most odorants cause _depolarization_ of the olfactory cell membrane, decreasing the negative potential in the cell from the normal level of −55 millivolts to −30 milli volts or less. Along with this, the number of action poten tials increases to 20 to 30 per second, which is a high rate for the minute olfactory nerve fibers.

Over a wide range, the rate of olfactory nerve impulses changes approximately in proportion to the logarithm of the stimulus strength, which demonstrates that the olfac tory receptors obey principles of transduction similar to those of other sensory receptors.

The olfac tory receptors adapt about 50% in the first second or so after stimulation. Thereafter, they adapt very little and very slowly. Yet, we all know from our own experience that smell sensations adapt almost to extinction within a minute or so after entering a strongly odorous atmos phere. Because this psychological adaptation is far greater than the degree of adaptation of the receptors, it is almost certain that most of the additional adaptation occurs in the central nervous system, which seems to be true for the adaptation of taste sensations as well.

The following neuronal mechanism for the adaptation is postulated: large numbers of centrifugal nerve fibers pass from the olfactory regions of the brain backward along the olfactory tract and terminate on special inhibi tory cells in the olfactory bulb, the _granule cells_. After the onset of an olfactory stimulus, the central nervous system quickly develops strong feedback inhibition to suppress relay of the smell signals through the olfactory bulb.
Search for the Primary Sensations of Smell

In the past, most physiologists were convinced that the many smell sensations are subserved by a few rather dis crete primary sensations in the same way that vision and taste are subserved by a few select primary sensations. On the basis of psychological studies, one attempt to classify these sensations is the following: 1. Camphoraceous 2. Musky 3. Floral 4. Pepperminty 5. Ethereal 6. Pungent 7. Putrid It is certain that this list does not represent the true primary sensations of smell. Multiple clues, including specific studies of the genes that encode for the recep tor proteins, suggest the existence of at least 100 primary sensations of smell—a marked contrast to only three pri mary sensations of color detected by the eyes and only five primary sensations of taste detected by the tongue. Some studies suggest that there may be as many as 1000 different types of odorant receptors. Further support for the many primary sensations of smell is that people have been found who have _odor blindness_ for single substances; such discrete odor blindness has been identified for more than 50 different substances. It is presumed that odor blindness for each substance represents lack of the appro priate receptor protein in olfactory cells for that particular substance.
Smell, even more so than taste, has the affective quality of either _pleasantness_ or

_unpleasantness_, and thus smell is probably even more important than taste for the selection of food. A person who has previously eaten food that disagreed with him or her is often nauseated by the smell of that same food on a second occasion. Conversely, perfume of the right quality can be a powerful stimulant of human emotions. In addi tion, in some animals, odors are the primary excitant of sexual drive.

One of the principal characteris tics of smell is the minute quantity of stimulating agent in the air that can elicit a smell sensation. For example, the substance _methylmercaptan_ can be smelled when only one 25 trillionth of a gram is present in each milliliter of air. Because of this very low threshold, this substance is mixed with natural gas to give the gas an odor that can be detected when even small amounts of gas leak from a pipeline.

Although the thresh old concentrations of substances that evoke smell are extremely slight, for many (if not most) odorants, con centrations only 10 to 50 times above the threshold evoke maximum intensity of smell. This range of intensity dis crimination is in contrast to most other sensory systems of the body, in which the ranges of intensity discrimina tion are tremendous—for example, 500,000 to 1 for the eyes and 1 trillion to 1 for the ears. This difference might be explained by the fact that smell is concerned more with detecting the presence or absence of odors rather than with quantitative detection of their intensities.
TRANSMISSION OF SMELL SIGNALS INTO THE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM

The olfactory portions of the brain were among the first brain structures developed in primitive animals, and much of the remainder of the brain developed around these olfactory beginnings. In fact, part of the brain that originally subserved olfaction later evolved into the basal brain structures that control emotions and other aspects of human behavior; we call this system the _limbic system_, as discussed in Chapter 59.

The _olfactory bulb_ is shown in **Figure 54-5**. The ol factory nerve fibers leading backward from the bulb are called _cranial nerve I_, or the _olfactory tract_. In reality, both the tract and the bulb are an anterior outgrowth of brain tissue from the base of the brain; the bulbous enlargement at its end, the _olfactory bulb_, lies over the _cribriform plate_, separating the brain cavity from the upper reaches of the nasal cavity. The cribriform plate has multiple small per forations through which an equal number of small nerves pass upward from the olfactory membrane in the nasal cavity to enter the olfactory bulb in the cranial cavity. **Figure 54-3** demonstrates the close relation between the _olfactory cells_ in the olfactory membrane and the olfac tory bulb, showing short axons from the olfactory cells terminating in multiple globular structures in the olfac tory bulb called _glomeruli_. Each bulb has several thousand such glomeruli, each of which is the terminus for about 25,000 axons from olfactory cells. Each glomerulus also is the terminus for dendrites from about 25 large _mitral cells_ and about 60 smaller _tufted cells_, the cell bodies of which lie in the olfactory bulb superior to the glomeruli. These dendrites receive synapses from the olfactory cell neurons; the mitral and tufted cells send axons through the olfactory tract to transmit olfactory signals to higher levels in the central nervous system.
full.lead: Transmission of Olfactory Signals Into the Olfactory Bulb.

full.text: Some research has suggested that different glomeruli respond to different odors. It is possible that specific glomeruli are the real clue to the analysis of different odor signals transmitted into the central nervous system.
Primitive and Newer Olfactory Pathways Into the Central Nervous System

The olfactory tract enters the brain at the anterior junc tion between the mesencephalon and cerebrum; there, the tract divides into two pathways, as shown in **Figure 54-5**, one passing medially into the _medial olfactory area_ of the brain stem and the other passing laterally into the _lateral olfactory area_. The medial olfactory area represents a very primitive olfactory system, whereas the lateral olfactory area is the input to the following: (1) a less old olfactory system; and (2) a newer system.

The medial olfactory area consists of a group of nu clei located in the midbasal portions of the brain imme diately anterior to the hypothalamus. Most conspicuous are the _septal nuclei_, which are midline nuclei that feed into the hypothalamus and other primitive portions of the brain’s limbic system. This is the brain area most con cerned with basic behavior (as described in Chapter 59).
full.lead: The Primitive Olfactory System—The Medial Olfactory Area.

full.text: The importance of this medial olfactory area is best understood by considering what happens in animals when the lateral olfactory areas on both sides of the brain are removed, and only the medial system remains. The removal of these areas hardly affects the more basic responses to olfaction, such as licking the lips, salivation, and other feeding responses caused by the smell of food or by basic emotional drives associated with smell. Con versely, removal of the lateral areas abolishes the more complicated olfactory conditioned reflexes.

The lateral olfactory area is composed mainly of the _prepyriform_ and _pyriform cortex_ plus the _cortical portion of the amygdaloid nuclei_. From these areas, signal path ways pass into almost all portions of the limbic system, especially into less primitive portions such as the hip pocampus, which seem to be most important for learning to like or dislike certain foods depending on one’s experi ences with them. For example, it is believed that this lateral olfactory area and its many connections with the limbic behavioral system cause a person to develop an absolute aversion to foods that have caused nausea and vomiting.
full.lead: The Less Old Olfactory System—The Lateral Olfactory Area.

full.text: An important feature of the lateral olfactory area is that many signal pathways from this area also feed directly into an _older part of the cerebral cortex_ called the _paleocortex_ in the _anteromedial portion of the temporal lobe_. This area is the only area of the entire cerebral cortex where sensory signals pass directly to the cortex without passing first through the thalamus.

A newer olfactory pathway that passes through the thalamus, passing to the dorsomedial thalamic nucleus and then to the lateroposterior quadrant of the orbitofrontale cortex, has been found. On the basis of studies in monkeys, this newer system probably helps in the conscious analysis of odor.

Thus, there appear to be a _primitive_ olfactory system that subserves the basic olfactory reflexes, a _less old_ system that provides automatic but partially learned control of food intake and aversion to toxic and unhealthy foods, and a _newer_ system that is comparable to most of the other cortical sensory systems and is used for con scious perception and analysis of olfaction.

Many nerve fibers that originate in the olfactory portions of the brain pass from the brain in the outward direction into the olfacto ry tract to the olfactory bulb (i.e., centrifugally from the brain to the periphery). These nerve fibers terminate on a large number of small _granule cells_ located among the mitral and tufted cells in the olfactory bulb. The granule cells send inhibitory signals to the mitral and tufted cells. This inhibitory feedback may be a means for sharpening a person’s specific ability to distinguish one odor from another.
full.lead: Centrifugal Control of Activity in the Olfactory Bulb by the Central Nervous System.

This change in electrical potential in the taste cell is called the receptor potential for taste
The ol- factory nerve fibers leading backward from the bulb are called cranial nerve I, or the olfactory tract

An important feature of the lateral olfactory area is that many signal pathways from this area also feed directly into an older part of the cerebral cortex called the paleocortex in the anteromedial portion of the temporal lobe

keyNumbers.text: A substance used frequently by psychologists for demonstrating taste blindness is phenylthiocarbamide, for which about 15% to 30% of all people exhibit taste blindness; the exact percentage depends on the method of testing and the concentration of the substance

The average life span of each taste cell is estimated to be about 10 days, although there is considerable variation, with some taste cells being eliminated in only 2 days while others may survive for over 3 weeks
Beyond the age of 45 years, many taste buds degenerate, causing taste sensitivity to decrease in old age
There are about 100 million of these cells in the olfactory epithelium interspersed among sustentacular cells, as shown in Figure 54-3

The mucosal end of the olfactory cell forms a knob from which 4 to 25 olfactory hairs (also called olfactory cilia), measuring 0.3 micrometer in diameter and up to 200 micrometers in length, project into the mucus that coats the inner surface of the nasal cavity
The membrane potential inside unstim- ulated olfactory cells, as measured by microelectrodes, averages about −55 millivolts
At this potential, most of the cells generate continuous action potentials at a very slow rate, varying from once every 20 seconds up to two or three per second
Most odorants cause depolarization of the olfactory cell membrane, decreasing the negative potential in the cell from the normal level of −55 millivolts to −30 millivolts or less
The olfac- tory receptors adapt about 50% in the first second or so after stimulation

Although the thresh- old concentrations of substances that evoke smell are extremely slight, for many (if not most) odorants, concentrations only 10 to 50 times above the threshold evoke maximum intensity of smell

The cAMP activates a gated sodium channel that increases sodium influx and depolarizes the cell, exciting the olfactory neuron and transmitting action potentials to the central nervous system.

ch54-f0.text: Ta’m va hid sezgilari bizga keraksiz yoki hatto öldiruvçi ovqatlarni yeyiş yoqimli va töyimli ovqatlardan ajratiş imkonini beradi. Ular, şuningdek, ovqatni hazm qiliş va undan foydalanişda iştirok etadigan fiziologik javoblarni yuzaga keltiradi. Hid sezgisi hayvonlarga boşqa hayvonlarning yaqinligini yoki hatto alohida hayvonlarni taniş imkonini beradi. Nihoyat, ikkala sezgi ham nerv tizimimizning primitiv emotsional va xulq-atvor funksiyalari bilan çambarças boğlangan. Bu bobda ta’m va hid qözğatuvçilari qanday aniqlanişi va ular miyaga uzatiladigan nerv signallarida qanday kodlanişi muhokama qilinadi.

ch54-f2.text: Ta’m asosan oğizdagi _ta’m kurtakçalarining_ funksiyasi, ammo hamma biladiki, hid sezgisi ham ta’mni idrok etişga kuçli hissa qöşadi. Bundan taşqari, oğizning teginiş sezgilari orqali aniqlanadigan ovqat tuzilişi (konsistensiyasi) va ovqatda qalampir kabi oğriq uçlarini qözğatadigan moddalarning bölişi ta’m taassurotini keskin özgartiradi. Ta’mning ahamiyati şundaki, u odamga ovqatni istaklariga va köpinça tana töqimalarining muayyan moddalarga metabolik ehtiyojiga muvofiq tanlaş imkonini beradi.

ch54-f4.text: Turli ta’m retseptorlarini qözğatadigan köplab muayyan kimyoviy moddalarning hammasi ham aniqlanmagan. Amaliy tahlil uçun _birlamçi ta’m sezgilari_ beşta umumiy toifaga guruhlangan — _nordon, şör, şirin, aççiq_ va “_umami_”.

ch54-f5.text: Odam yuzlab turli ta’mlarni idrok eta oladi. 51-bobda tasvirlanganidek, biz köra oladigan barça ranglar uçta asosiy rangning birikmalari bölgani kabi, ularning barçasi ham elementar ta’m sezgilarining birikmalari deb hisoblanadi.

ch54-f6.text: Nordon ta’mni kislotalar, ya’ni vodorod ioni konsentratsiyasi keltirib çiqaradi va bu ta’m sezgisining jadalligi taxminan _vodorod ioni konsentratsiyasining logarifmiga_ mutanosib (ya’ni ovqat qança kislotali bölsa, nordon sezgi şunça kuçli böladi).

ch54-f7.text: Şör ta’mni ionlaşgan tuzlar, asosan natriy ioni konsentratsiyasi yuzaga keltiradi. Ta’m sifati bir tuzdan boşqasiga biroz farq qiladi, çunki ayrim tuzlar şörlikdan taşqari boşqa ta’m sezgilarini ham yuzaga keltiradi. Şör ta’m uçun asosan tuzlarning kationlari, ayniqsa natriy kationlari javobgar, ammo anionlar ham kamroq darajada hissa qöşadi.

ch54-f8.text: Şirin ta’mni kimyoviy moddalarning heç bir yagona sinfi keltirib çiqarmaydi. Bu ta’mni keltirib çiqaradigan kimyoviy moddalarning ayrim turlariga qandlar, glikollar, spirtlar, aldegidlar, ketonlar, amidlar, efirlar, ayrim aminokislotalar, ayrim mayda oqsillar, sulfokislotalar, galogenlangan kislotalar hamda qörğoşin va berilliyning anorganik tuzlari kiradi. Ayniqsa e’tibor bering: şirin ta’m keltirib çiqaradigan moddalarning köpçiligi organik kimyoviy moddalardir. Kimyoviy tuzilişdagi kiçik özgarişlar, masalan, oddiy radikalning qöşilişi köpinça moddani şirindan aççiqqa aylantirişi ayniqsa qiziq.

ch54-f9.text: Aççiq ta’mni ham şirin ta’m kabi kimyoviy vositaning heç bir yagona turi keltirib çiqarmaydi. Bu yerda ham aççiq ta’m beradigan moddalar deyarli butunlay organik moddalardir. Moddalarning ikki alohida sinfi ayniqsa aççiq ta’m sezgilarini keltirib çiqariş ehtimoli yuqori: (1) azot saqlovçi uzun zanjirli organik moddalar; va (2) alkaloidlar. Alkaloidlarga xinin, kofein, strixnin va nikotin kabi tibbiyotda işlatiladigan köplab dorilar kiradi.

ch54-f10.text: Dastlab şirin ta’mli bölgan ayrim moddalarning keyin aççiq ta’mi qoladi. Bu xususiyat saxaringa xos bölib, bu moddani ayrim odamlar uçun yoqimsiz qiladi. Tuzlarning yuqori konsentratsiyalari ham aççiq ta’mga olib kelişi mumkin.

ch54-f11.text: Aççiq ta’m yuqori jadallikda yuzaga kelganda odatda odam yoki hayvonni ovqatdan voz keçişga majbur qiladi. Bu reaksiya şubhasiz aççiq ta’m sezgisining muhim funksiyasidir, çunki zaharli ösimliklarda uçraydigan köplab öldiruvçi toksinlar alkaloidlardir va bu alkaloidlarning deyarli barçasi kuçli aççiq ta’mni yuzaga keltiradi, odatda undan keyin ovqatdan voz keçiladi.

ch54-f12.text: Yapon tilida “mazali” ma’nosini bildiradigan _umami_ sözi nordon, şör, şirin yoki aççiqdan sifat jihatidan farq qiladigan yoqimli ta’m sezgisini bildiradi. Umami göşt ekstraktlari va etilgan pişloq kabi _L-glutamat_ saqlovçi ovqatning ustun ta’midir. Umami ta’mining yoqimli sezgisi oqsillarni iste’mol qilişga undaş orqali ovqatlaniş uçun muhim deb hisoblanadi.

ch54-f14.text: Xlorid kislota bilan nordon ta’mni qözğatişning molyar bösağasi örtaça 0,0009 M, natriy xlorid bilan şör ta’mni qözğatiş uçun 0,01 M, saxaroza bilan şirin ta’m uçun 0,01 M va xinin bilan aççiq ta’m uçun 0,000008 M. Ayniqsa e’tibor bering: aççiq ta’m sezgisi boşqa barça sezgilarga qaraganda ança sezgirroq. Bu ovqatdagi köplab xavfli toksinlarga qarşi muhim himoya funksiyasini ta’minlaydi.

ch54-f15.text: **Jadval 54-1** da turli moddalarning nisbiy ta’m indekslari (ta’m bösağalarining teskari qiymatlari) keltirilgan. Bu jadvalda ta’mning törtta birlamçi sezgisining jadalliklari mos ravişda xlorid kislota, xinin, saxaroza va natriy xlorid ta’mining jadalliklariga nisbatan olingan; ularning har biri uçun ta’m indeksi şartli ravişda 1 deb tanlangan.

ch54-f17.text: Ayrim odamlar muayyan moddalarga, ayniqsa tiomoçevina birikmalarining turli xillariga ta’m körligiga ega. Psixologlar ta’m körligini körsatiş uçun köp işlatadigan modda — _feniltiokarbamid_. Barça odamlarning taxminan 15–30% ida unga ta’m körligi namoyon böladi; aniq foiz tekşiriş usuli va modda konsentratsiyasiga boğliq.

ch54-f19.text: **Rasm 54-1B** da diametri taxminan millimetrning 1/30 qismi, uzunligi esa taxminan millimetrning 1/16 qismi bölgan ta’m kurtakçasi körsatilgan. Ta’m kurtakçasi epiteliy hujayralaridan iborat: ularning ayrimlari _tayanç (sustentakulyar) hujayralar_ deb ataladigan tayanç hujayralar, boşqalari esa _ta’m hujayralari_ deb ataladi. Har bir ta’m kurtakçasida taxminan 100 ta ta’m hujayrasi bor. Ta’m hujayralari atrofdagi epiteliy hujayralarining mitotik bölinişi hisobiga uzluksiz almaşinib turadi, şuning uçun ayrim ta’m hujayralari yoş hujayralar. Boşqalari kurtakça markaziga yaqin joylaşgan yetuk hujayralar; bu hujayralar tez orada parçalanib, erib ketadi. Har bir ta’m hujayrasining örtaça yaşaş muddati taxminan 10 kun deb baholanadi, garçi ança farq bölsa ham: ayrim ta’m hujayralari atigi 2 kunda yöq qilinadi, boşqalari esa 3 haftadan ortiq yaşaşi mumkin.

ch54-f21.text: Ta’m hujayralarining taşqi uçlari **Rasm 54-1B** da körsatilgan mitti _ta’m teşigi_ atrofida joylaşgan. Har bir ta’m hujayrasining uçidan bir neça _mikrovorsinkalar_ yoki _ta’m tukçalari_ oğiz böşliğiga yaqinlaşiş uçun ta’m teşigiga qarab taşqariga çiqib turadi. Bu mikrovorsinkalar ta’m uçun retseptor yuzani ta’minlaydi.

ch54-f22.text: Ta’m hujayralari tanalari atrofida ta’m retseptor hujayralari qözğatadigan _ta’m nerv tolalarining_ tarmoqlanuvçi terminal töri örilgan. Bu tolalarning ayrimlari ta’m hujayralari membranalarining burmalariga botib kiradi. Hujayra membranasi ostida tolalar yonida köplab pufakçalar hosil böladi. Bu pufakçalarda ta’m qözğalişiga javoban nerv tolasi uçlarini qözğatiş uçun hujayra membranasi orqali ajraladigan neyromediator modda bor, deb hisoblanadi.

ch54-f23.text: Ta’m kurtakçalari tilning uç turdagi sörğiçlarida joylaşgan (qarang: **Rasm 54-1A**): (1) köp sonli ta’m kurtakçalari til orqa qismining yuzasida V-simon çiziq hosil qiladigan _novsimon sörğiçlarni_ örab turgan ariqçalar devorlarida; (2) örtaça miqdorda tilning yon yuzalari böylab burmalarda joylaşgan _bargsimon sörğiçlarda_; va (3) örtaça miqdorda ta’m kurtakçalari tilning yassi oldingi yuzasidagi _qöziqorinsimon sörğiçlarda_. Qöşimça ta’m kurtakçalari tanglayda, bir neçtasi esa bodomsimon bez ravoqlarida, hiqildoq usti toğayida va hatto qizilöngaçning proksimal qismida joylaşgan. Katta yoşlilarda 3000 dan 10 000 gaça ta’m kurtakçasi bor, bolalarda esa biroz köproq. 45 yoşdan keyin köplab ta’m kurtakçalari degeneratsiyaga uçraydi va keksalikda ta’m sezgirligining pasayişiga sabab böladi.

ch54-f24.text: Alohida ta’m kurtakçalarida ötkazilgan mikroelektrod tadqiqotlari har bir ta’m kurtakçasi odatda _ta’m moddasi past konsentratsiyada bölganda beşta birlamçi ta’m qözğatuvçisidan asosan bittasiga javob berişini_ körsatadi. Biroq yuqori konsentratsiyada köpçilik kurtakçalar birlamçi ta’m qözğatuvçilarining ikkitasi yoki undan köpi, şuningdek “birlamçi” toifalarga kirmaydigan bir neça boşqa ta’m qözğatuvçilari bilan qözğalişi mumkin.
ch54-f24.lead: Ta’m kurtakçalarining birlamçi ta’m qözğatuvçisiga öziga xosligi.

ch54-f26.text: Ta’m hujayrasining membranasi köpçilik boşqa sezgi retseptor hujayralarinikidek içki tomondan taşqi tomonga nisbatan manfiy zaryadlangan. Ta’m tukçalariga ta’m moddasining ta’sir qilişi bu manfiy potensialning qisman yöqolişiga sabab böladi — ya’ni ta’m hujayrasi _depolyarizatsiyalanadi_. Köp hollarda potensialning pasayişi keng diapazonda qözğatuvçi modda konsentratsiyasining logarifmiga taxminan mutanosib. Ta’m hujayrasidagi bu _elektr potensialining özgarişi_ ta’mning _retseptor potensiali_ deb ataladi.

ch54-f27.text: Köpçilik qözğatuvçi moddalarning ta’m vorsinkalari bilan reaksiyaga kirişib, retseptor potensialini boşlab beriş mexanizmi ta’m kimyoviy moddasining ta’m retseptor hujayrasining taşqi yuzasida, vorsinka membranasi yonida yoki undan çiqib turgan oqsil retseptor molekulasi bilan boğlanişidir. Bu ta’sir öz navbatida ion kanallarini oçadi va musbat zaryadli natriy ionlari yoki vodorod ionlarining kirib, hujayraning me’yoriy manfiyligini depolyarizatsiyalaşiga imkon beradi. Söngra ta’m kimyoviy moddasi sölak bilan ta’m vorsinkasidan asta-sekin yuvilib ketadi va bu qözğatuvçini olib taşlaydi.

ch54-f28.text: Har bir ta’m vorsinkasidagi retseptor oqsilining turi idrok etiladigan ta’m turini belgilaydi. Mos ravişda şör va nordon ta’m sezgilarini yuzaga keltiradigan natriy ionlari va vodorod ionlari uçun retseptor oqsillar ta’m hujayralarining apikal membranalaridagi muayyan ion kanallarini, ehtimol epitelial natriy kanalini (ENaC) oçadi va şu bilan retseptorlarni faollaştiradi. Biroq şirin va aççiq ta’m sezgilari uçun G-oqsil bilan boğlangan retseptorlarning apikal membranalar orqali çiqib turgan qismlari ta’m hujayralari içidagi _ikkilamçi vositaçi mediator moddalarni_ faollaştiradi. Bu ikkilamçi vositaçilar ta’m signallarini yuzaga keltiradigan hujayra içi kimyoviy özgarişlarga sabab böladi.

ch54-f29.text: Şirin ta’mli birikmalar bir-biriga yaqin boğliq ikki G-oqsil bilan boğlangan ta’m retseptori — T1R2 va T1R3 ning birikmasi orqali aniqlanadi. Umami ta’mi uçun javobgar retseptorlar T1R1 va T1R3 oqsillarining kompleksi deb hisoblanadi. Şunday qilib, T1R3 şirin va umami ta’mlari uçun ko-retseptor vazifasini bajaradiganga öxşaydi.

ch54-f30.text: Aççiq ta’mni taxminan 30 xil G-oqsil bilan boğlangan retseptorlarning boşqa oilasi (T2R) sezadi. Alohida aççiqni sezuvçi ta’m retseptor hujayralari bir neça T2R ni ekspressiya qiladi va ularning har biri aççiq birikmalarning öziga xos töplamini taniydi. Retseptorlar ekspressiyasining bu tartibi bitta turdagi ta’m retseptor hujayrasi orqali turli aççiq birikmalarni aniqlaş imkonini beradi.

ch54-f31.text: Kislotali ovqat yoki içimlik bilan boğliq nordon ta’m vodorod ionlari bilan oçiladigan ion kanallari orqali seziladi, deb hisoblanadi, garçi aniq mexanizmlar töliq tuşunilmagan bölsa ham. Yaqindagi tadqiqotlar kislotaga sezgir kaliy kanali (KIR2.1) va vodorod ioniga tanlab ötkazuvçan ion kanali (otopetrin 1) ta’m retseptor hujayralarida kislotaga javoblarni ta’minlaşi mumkinligini körsatadi.

ch54-f32.text: Ta’m qözğatuvçisi birinçi ta’sir qilganda ta’m kurtakçalaridan çiqadigan nerv tolalarining razryadlaniş tezligi soniyaning kiçik bir qismi içida çöqqiga köteriladi, ammo keyin ta’m qözğatuvçisi ta’sir qilib turar ekan, keyingi bir neça soniya içida pastroq barqaror darajaga adaptatsiyalanadi. Şunday qilib, ta’m nervi orqali kuçli bir zumlik signal uzatiladi va ta’m kurtakçasi ta’m qözğatuvçisiga duç kelib turar ekan, kuçsizroq uzluksiz signal uzatiladi.
ch54-f32.lead: Ta’m kurtakçasi tomonidan nerv impulslarining hosil qilinişi.

ch54-f33.text: Ta’m signallarining markaziy nerv tizimiga uzatilişi

ch54-f34.text: **Rasm 54-1** va **Rasm 54-2** da ta’m signallarini til va halqum sohasidan markaziy nerv tizimiga uzatadigan neyron yöllari körsatilgan. Tilning oldingi uçdan ikki qismidan keladigan ta’m impulslari avval _til nerviga_, söngra _noğora tori_ orqali _yuz nerviga_ va nihoyat miya stvolidagi _yakka yölga_ (tractus solitarius) ötadi. Til orqasidagi novsimon sörğiçlardan va oğiz hamda tomoqning boşqa orqa sohalaridan keladigan ta’m sezgilari _til-halqum nervi_ orqali yana yakka yölga, ammo biroz orqaroq sathga uzatiladi. Nihoyat, bir neça ta’m signallari til asosidan va halqum sohasining boşqa qismlaridan yakka yölga _adaşgan nerv_ orqali uzatiladi.

ch54-f36.text: Barça ta’m tolalari miya stvolining orqa qismida yakka yöl yadrolarida sinaps hosil qiladi. Bu yadrolar ikkinçi tartibli neyronlarni orqa ustun–medial qovuzloq tizimining yuz sohalari talamusda tugaydigan joydan biroz medialda joylaşgan _talamusning ventral orqa medial yadrosining_ kiçik sohasiga yuboradi. Talamusdan uçinçi tartibli neyronlar _tepa bölagi pöstloğidagi markaziy egatdan keyingi puştaning pastki uçiga_ — u _Silviy egatiga çuqur buralib kiradigan_ joyga va qöşni _qopqoq-orolça sohasiga_ boradi. Bu soha boş miya I somatik sohasidagi til teginiş signallari sohasidan biroz lateralda, ventralda va rostralda joylaşgan. Ta’m yöllarining bu tavsifidan ular tildan keladigan somatosensor yöllarga juda yaqin parallel ekani aniq.

ch54-f37.text: Yakka yöldan köplab ta’m signallari miya stvolining özida bevosita _yuqori_ va _pastki sölak yadrolariga_ uzatiladi. Bu sohalar ovqatni iste’mol qiliş va hazm qiliş vaqtida sölak ajralişini boşqarişga yordam beriş uçun jağ osti, til osti va quloq oldi bezlariga signallar uzatadi.

ch54-f38.text: Hamma ta’m sezgilari tez, köpinça uzluksiz qözğatişdan keyin taxminan bir daqiqa içida deyarli töliq adaptatsiyalanişini biladi. Biroq ta’m nervi tolalarining elektrofiziologik tadqiqotlaridan ta’m kurtakçalarining adaptatsiyasi odatda bu tez ta’m adaptatsiyasining taxminan yarmidan köp qismini taşkil etmasligi aniq. Şuning uçun ta’m sezgisida yuz beradigan adaptatsiyaning yakuniy keskin darajasi deyarli aniq markaziy nerv tizimida yuz beradi, garçi mexanizmlari ma’lum bölmasa ham. Adaptatsiyaning bu mexanizmi asosan retseptorlarda adaptatsiyalanadigan köplab boşqa sezgi tizimlarinikidan farq qiladi.

ch54-f40.text: _Ta’m afzalligi_ şunçaki hayvon ayrim turdagi ovqatlarni boşqalaridan afzal körib tanlaşini bildiradi va hayvon nima yeyişini boşqarişga yordam beriş uçun bu afzallikdan avtomatik foydalanadi. Bundan taşqari, uning ta’m afzalliklari köpinça organizmning muayyan moddalarga ehtiyojiga muvofiq özgaradi.

ch54-f41.text: Quyidagi tajribalar hayvonlarning ovqatni organizm ehtiyojlariga muvofiq tanlaş qobiliyatini körsatadi. Birinçidan, buyrak usti bezlari olib taşlangan, _tuz kamaygan_ hayvonlar avtomatik ravişda toza suvdan köra natriy xlorid konsentratsiyasi yuqori bölgan içimlik suvini tanlaydi va suvdagi natriy xlorid miqdori köpinça organizm ehtiyojlarini qondiriş va tuz kamayişi tufayli ölimning oldini oliş uçun yetarli böladi. Ikkinçidan, ortiqça miqdorda insulin yuborilgan hayvonda qondagi qand darajasi kamayadi va hayvon köp namunalar orasidan avtomatik ravişda eng şirin ovqatni tanlaydi. Uçinçidan, kalsiy kamaygan, qalqonsimon bez oldi bezlari olib taşlangan hayvonlar avtomatik ravişda kalsiy xlorid konsentratsiyasi yuqori bölgan içimlik suvini tanlaydi.

ch54-f42.text: Xuddi şu hodisalar kundalik hayotda ham kuzatiladi. Masalan, çöl hududlaridagi “tuz yalaş joylari” hayvonlarni uzoq-uzoqlardan jalb qilişi ma’lum. Bundan taşqari, odamlar yoqimsiz emotsional sezgi beradigan ovqatni rad etadi va bu köp hollarda organizmimizni keraksiz moddalardan himoya qiladi.

ch54-f43.text: Ta’m afzalligi hodisasi deyarli aniq ta’m retseptorlaridagi mexanizm emas, markaziy nerv tizimida joylaşgan qandaydir mexanizm natijasidir, garçi retseptorlar köpinça zarur ozuqa moddasi foydasiga sezgirlaşsa ham. Ta’m afzalligi asosan markaziy nerv tizimi hodisasi ekaniga işoniş uçun muhim sabab şuki, yoqimsiz yoki yoqimli ta’mlar bilan oldingi tajriba odamning ta’m afzalliklarini belgilaşda katta rol öynaydi. Masalan, agar odam muayyan turdagi ovqatni yegandan keyin tez orada kasal bölib qolsa, u odatda şu ovqatga nisbatan salbiy ta’m afzalligini, ya’ni _ta’mdan jirkaniş_ni rivojlantiradi; xuddi şu ta’sirni tuban hayvonlarda ham körsatiş mumkin.

ch54-f45.text: Hid sezgilarimiz içida eng kam tuşunilganidir. Bu qisman hid sezgisining tuban hayvonlarda oson örganib bölmaydigan subyektiv hodisa ekanligi bilan boğliq. Yana bir murakkablaştiruvçi muammo şundaki, odamda hid sezgisi köplab boşqa sutemizuvçilardagi hid sezgisiga qaraganda yomon rivojlangan.

ch54-f47.text: Gistologiyasi **Rasm 54-3** da körsatilgan hid biliş membranasi burun böşliğining yuqori qismida joylaşgan. Medial tomonda hid biliş membranasi yuqori burun töşiği yuzasi böylab pastga buriladi; lateral tomonda u yuqori burun çiğanoği ustiga va hatto örta burun çiğanoği yuqori yuzasining kiçik qismi ustiga buriladi. Odamda hid biliş membranasining umumiy yuzasi taxminan 5 kvadrat santimetr.

ch54-f49.text: _Hid biliş hujayralari_ (qarang: **Rasm 54-3**) aslida dastlab markaziy nerv tizimidan kelib çiqqan bipolyar nerv hujayralaridir. **Rasm 54-3** da körsatilganidek, hid biliş epiteliysida _tayanç hujayralar_ orasida bunday hujayralardan taxminan 100 million tasi bor. Hid biliş hujayrasining şilliq qavat tomonidagi uçi tugmaça hosil qiladi va undan diametri 0,3 mikrometr, uzunligi 200 mikrometrgaça bölgan 4 dan 25 tagaça _hid biliş tukçalari_ (ular _hid biliş kiprikçalari_ deb ham ataladi) burun böşliğining içki yuzasini qoplab turgan şilliqqa çiqib turadi. Bu çiqib turgan hid biliş kiprikçalari şilliqda ziç qatlam hosil qiladi va keyinroq muhokama qilinganidek, aynan şu kiprikçalar havodagi hidlarga reaksiya qilib, hid biliş hujayralarini qözğatadi. Hid biliş membranasidagi hid biliş hujayralari orasida hid biliş membranasi yuzasiga şilliq ajratadigan köplab mayda _Boumen bezlari_ joylaşgan.
ch54-f49.lead: Hid biliş hujayralari hid sezgisining retseptor hujayralaridir.

ch54-f51.text: Har bir hid biliş hujayrasining hid beruvçi kimyoviy qözğatuvçilarga javob beradigan qismi — _hid biliş kiprikçalari_. Hidli modda hid biliş membranasi yuzasiga tegganda avval kiprikçalarni qoplab turgan şilliqqa diffuziyalanadi, söngra har bir kiprikça membranasidagi _retseptor oqsillar_ bilan boğlanadi (**Rasm 54-4**). Har bir retseptor oqsil aslida membrana orqali taxminan yetti marta içkariga va taşqariga buralib ötadigan uzun molekuladir.

ch54-f53.text: Hidli modda retseptor oqsilning taşqariga buralgan qismi bilan boğlanadi. Buralgan oqsilning içki qismi özi uçta subbirlikdan iborat bölgan _G-oqsil_ bilan boğlangan. Retseptor oqsil qözğalganda G-oqsildan _alfa_ subbirlik ajralib çiqadi va retseptor hujayra tanasi yonida kiprikça membranasining içki tomoniga birikkan _adenilatsiklazani_ faollaştiradi. Faollaşgan siklaza öz navbatida hujayra içidagi _adenozin trifosfatning_ (ATF) köplab molekulalarini _siklik adenozin monofosfatga_ (sAMF) aylantiradi. Nihoyat bu sAMF yaqin atrofdagi boşqa membrana oqsilini — _boşqariladigan natriy ion kanalini_ faollaştiradi. U öz “darvozasini” oçadi va köp sonli natriy ionlarining membrana orqali retseptor hujayra sitoplazmasiga oqib kirişiga imkon beradi. Natriy ionlari hujayra membranasi içidagi elektr potensialini musbat tomonga oşiradi va şu bilan hid biliş neyronini qözğatib, harakat potensiallarini _hid biliş nervi_ orqali markaziy nerv tizimiga uzatadi.

ch54-f54.text: Hid biliş nervlarini faollaştirişning bu mexanizmining ahamiyati şundaki, u hatto eng kuçsiz hidli moddaning ham qözğatuvçi ta’sirini keskin köpaytiradi. Xulosa qilsak: (1) retseptor oqsilning hidli modda bilan faollaşişi G-oqsil kompleksini faollaştiradi, u esa öz navbatida (2) hid biliş hujayrasi membranasi içida adenilatsiklazaning köplab molekulalarini faollaştiradi, bu (3) köp baravar köproq sAMF molekulalari hosil bölişiga sabab böladi va nihoyat (4) sAMF yana köp baravar köproq natriy ion kanallarini oçadi. Şuning uçun muayyan hidli moddaning hatto juda kiçik konsentratsiyasi ham juda köp sonli natriy kanallarini oçadigan kaskad ta’sirni boşlab beradi. Bu jarayon hid biliş neyronlarining hidli moddaning hatto eng kiçik miqdoriga ham juda yuqori sezgirligini tuşuntiradi.

ch54-f55.text: Hid biliş hujayralari qözğaladigan asosiy kimyoviy mexanizmdan taşqari, bir neça fizik omil qözğaliş darajasiga ta’sir qiladi. Birinçidan, faqat burun böşliğiga hidlab tortib olinişi mumkin bölgan uçuvçan moddalarnigina hidlaş mumkin. Ikkinçidan, qözğatuvçi modda hid biliş kiprikçalariga yetiş uçun şilliqdan öta oliş maqsadida heç bölmaganda biroz suvda eriydigan bölişi kerak. Uçinçidan, moddaning heç bölmaganda biroz lipidlarda erişi foydali, çunki ehtimol kiprikçaning lipid tarkibiy qismlari lipidlarda erimaydigan hidli moddalar uçun kuçsiz tösiqdir.

ch54-f56.text: Mikroelektrodlar bilan ölçanganda qözğatilmagan hid biliş hujayralari içidagi membrana potensiali örtaça taxminan −55 millivolt. Bu potensialda hujayralarning köpçiligi har 20 soniyada bir martadan soniyasiga ikki-uç martagaça özgaradigan juda sekin tezlikda uzluksiz harakat potensiallarini hosil qiladi.
ch54-f56.lead: Hid biliş hujayralaridagi membrana potensiallari va harakat potensiallari.

ch54-f57.text: Köpçilik hidli moddalar hid biliş hujayrasi membranasining _depolyarizatsiyasiga_ sabab böladi va hujayradagi manfiy potensialni me’yoriy −55 millivolt darajasidan −30 millivolt yoki undan kamgaça kamaytiradi. Bu bilan birga harakat potensiallari soni soniyasiga 20–30 tagaça ortadi, bu mitti hid biliş nervi tolalari uçun yuqori tezlik.

ch54-f58.text: Keng diapazonda hid biliş nervi impulslari tezligi qözğatuvçi kuçining logarifmiga taxminan mutanosib özgaradi. Bu hid biliş retseptorlari boşqa sezgi retseptorlarinikiga öxşaş transduksiya tamoyillariga böysunişini körsatadi.

ch54-f59.text: Hid biliş retseptorlari qözğatilgandan keyingi taxminan birinçi soniyada taxminan 50% ga adaptatsiyalanadi. Şundan keyin ular juda kam va juda sekin adaptatsiyalanadi. Biroq hammamiz öz tajribamizdan bilamizki, kuçli hidli muhitga kirgandan keyin taxminan bir daqiqa içida hid sezgilari deyarli yöqolgunça adaptatsiyalanadi. Bu psixologik adaptatsiya retseptorlar adaptatsiyasi darajasidan ança katta bölgani uçun qöşimça adaptatsiyaning köp qismi deyarli aniq markaziy nerv tizimida yuz beradi. Bu ta’m sezgilarining adaptatsiyasi uçun ham töğri bölib körinadi.

ch54-f60.text: Adaptatsiyaning quyidagi neyron mexanizmi taxmin qilinadi: köp sonli markazdan qoçma nerv tolalari miyaning hid biliş sohalaridan hid biliş yöli böylab orqaga ötadi va hid biliş piyozçasidagi maxsus tormozlovçi hujayralar — _donador hujayralarda_ tugaydi. Hid qözğatuvçisi boşlangaçdan keyin markaziy nerv tizimi hid signallarining hid biliş piyozçasi orqali relelanişini bostiriş uçun tezda kuçli teskari aloqa tormozlanişini rivojlantiradi.

ch54-f62.text: Ilgari köpçilik fiziologlar köriş va ta’mga bir neça tanlangan birlamçi sezgilar xizmat qilgani kabi köplab hid sezgilariga ham bir neça ança alohida birlamçi sezgilar xizmat qiladi, deb işongan. Psixologik tadqiqotlar asosida bu sezgilarni tasniflaşga urinişlardan biri quyidagiça: 1. Kamforasimon 2. Muşksimon 3. Gulsimon 4. Yalpizsimon 5. Efirsimon 6. Ötkir 7. Çirigan hidli. Bu röyxat hidning haqiqiy birlamçi sezgilarini ifodalamasligi aniq. Köplab dalillar, jumladan retseptor oqsillarni kodlaydigan genlarning maxsus tadqiqotlari hidning kamida 100 ta birlamçi sezgisi mavjudligini körsatadi — bu közlar aniqlaydigan atigi uçta birlamçi rang sezgisi va til aniqlaydigan atigi beşta birlamçi ta’m sezgisiga keskin qarama-qarşi. Ayrim tadqiqotlar hid retseptorlarining 1000 tagaça turli turi bölişi mumkinligini körsatadi. Hidning köplab birlamçi sezgilari borligini yana tasdiqlaydigan dalil şuki, alohida moddalarga _hid körligi_ bölgan odamlar topilgan; bunday alohida hid körligi 50 dan ortiq turli moddalar uçun aniqlangan. Har bir modda uçun hid körligi hid biliş hujayralarida şu modda uçun tegişli retseptor oqsilning yöqligini ifodalaydi, deb taxmin qilinadi.

ch54-f64.text: _yoqimsizlik_ emotsional sifatiga ega, şuning uçun hid ovqatni tanlaş uçun ehtimol ta’mdan ham muhimroq. Ilgari öziga yoqmagan ovqatni yegan odam keyingi safar xuddi şu ovqatning hididan köpinça köngli aynaydi. Aksinça, töğri sifatdagi atir inson his-tuyğularining kuçli qözğatuvçisi bölişi mumkin. Bundan taşqari, ayrim hayvonlarda hidlar jinsiy mayl uyğotuvçi asosiy qözğatuvçidir.

ch54-f65.text: Hidning asosiy xususiyatlaridan biri — havoda hid sezgisini yuzaga keltira oladigan qözğatuvçi vositaning juda kiçik miqdori. Masalan, _metilmerkaptan_ moddasini havoning har bir millilitrida grammning atigi 25 trilliondan bir qismi bölganda ham hidlaş mumkin. Bu juda past bösağa tufayli bu modda tabiiy gazga gaz quvuridan hatto oz miqdorda sizib çiqqanda ham aniqlaş mumkin bölgan hid beriş uçun aralaştiriladi.

ch54-f66.text: Hid yuzaga keltiradigan moddalarning bösağa konsentratsiyalari juda kiçik bölsa-da, köp (agar köpçilik bölmasa) hidli moddalar uçun bösağadan atigi 10–50 baravar yuqori konsentratsiyalar hidning maksimal jadalligini yuzaga keltiradi. Jadallikni farqlaşning bu diapazoni organizmning köpçilik boşqa sezgi tizimlaridan farq qiladi: ularda jadallikni farqlaş diapazonlari juda katta — masalan, közlar uçun 500 000:1, quloqlar uçun esa 1 trillion:1. Bu farqni hid sezgisi hidlarning jadalligini miqdoriy aniqlaşdan köra ularning bor-yöqligini aniqlaş bilan köproq boğliq ekanligi bilan tuşuntiriş mumkin.

ch54-f67.text: Hid signallarining markaziy nerv tizimiga uzatilişi

ch54-f68.text: Miyaning hid biliş qismlari primitiv hayvonlarda rivojlangan birinçi miya tuzilmalaridan biri bölgan va miyaning qolgan qismining köp qismi şu hid biliş boşlanğiçlari atrofida rivojlangan. Aslida dastlab hid biliş funksiyasini bajargan miya qismi keyinroq his-tuyğular va inson xulq-atvorining boşqa jihatlarini boşqaradigan miyaning bazal tuzilmalariga aylangan; 59-bobda muhokama qilinganidek, biz bu tizimni _limbik tizim_ deb ataymiz.

ch54-f69.text: _Hid biliş piyozçasi_ **Rasm 54-5** da körsatilgan. Piyozçadan orqaga boradigan hid biliş nerv tolalari _I boş miya nervi_ yoki _hid biliş yöli_ deb ataladi. Aslida yöl ham, piyozça ham miya asosidan çiqqan miya töqimasining oldingi ösimtasidir. Uning uçidagi piyozsimon kengayma — _hid biliş piyozçasi_ miya böşliğini burun böşliğining yuqori qismlaridan ajratib turadigan _ğalvirsimon plastinka_ ustida joylaşgan. Ğalvirsimon plastinkada köplab mayda teşikçalar bor va ular orqali burun böşliğidagi hid biliş membranasidan teng sonli mayda nervlar yuqoriga ötib, kalla böşliğidagi hid biliş piyozçasiga kiradi. **Rasm 54-3** da hid biliş membranasidagi _hid biliş hujayralari_ va hid biliş piyozçasi orasidagi yaqin munosabat körsatilgan: hid biliş hujayralarining qisqa aksonlari hid biliş piyozçasidagi _glomerulalar_ deb ataluvçi köplab şarsimon tuzilmalarda tugaydi. Har bir piyozçada bir neça ming bunday glomerula bor va ularning har biri hid biliş hujayralaridan keladigan taxminan 25 000 ta aksonning tugaş joyidir. Har bir glomerula, şuningdek, hujayra tanalari hid biliş piyozçasida glomerulalardan yuqorida joylaşgan taxminan 25 ta yirik _mitral hujayralar_ va taxminan 60 ta kiçikroq _popuksimon hujayralar_ dendritlarining tugaş joyidir. Bu dendritlar hid biliş hujayralari neyronlaridan sinapslar oladi; mitral va popuksimon hujayralar hid signallarini markaziy nerv tizimining yuqori sathlariga uzatiş uçun hid biliş yöli orqali aksonlar yuboradi.
ch54-f69.lead: Hid signallarining hid biliş piyozçasiga uzatilişi.

ch54-f71.text: Ayrim tadqiqotlar turli glomerulalar turli hidlarga javob berişini körsatgan. Muayyan glomerulalar markaziy nerv tizimiga uzatiladigan turli hid signallarini tahlil qilişning haqiqiy kaliti bölişi mumkin.

ch54-f72.text: Markaziy nerv tizimiga boradigan primitiv va yangiroq hid biliş yöllari

ch54-f73.text: Hid biliş yöli miyaga örta miya va katta miya orasidagi oldingi tutaşma joyida kiradi; u yerda **Rasm 54-5** da körsatilganidek, yöl ikki yölga bölinadi: biri medial tomonga, miya stvolining _medial hid biliş sohasiga_, ikkinçisi esa lateral tomonga, _lateral hid biliş sohasiga_ ötadi. Medial hid biliş sohasi juda primitiv hid biliş tizimini ifodalaydi, lateral hid biliş sohasi esa quyidagilarga kiriş hisoblanadi: (1) unçalik qadimiy bölmagan hid biliş tizimi; va (2) yangiroq tizim.

ch54-f74.text: Medial hid biliş sohasi miyaning örta-bazal qismlarida gipotalamusning bevosita oldida joylaşgan yadrolar guruhidan iborat. Eng yaqqoli — gipotalamusga va miya limbik tizimining boşqa primitiv qismlariga signallar beradigan örta çiziq yadrolari bölgan _töşiq yadrolari_. Bu miyaning asosiy xulq-atvor bilan eng köp boğliq sohasi (59-bobda tasvirlanganidek).
ch54-f74.lead: Primitiv hid biliş tizimi — medial hid biliş sohasi.

ch54-f75.text: Bu medial hid biliş sohasining ahamiyatini miyaning ikkala tomonidagi lateral hid biliş sohalari olib taşlanib, faqat medial tizim qolganda hayvonlarda nima yuz berişini körib çiqib, eng yaxşi tuşuniş mumkin. Bu sohalarni olib taşlaş hidga nisbatan ança asosiy javoblarga — lablarni yalaş, sölak ajraliş va ovqat hidi yoki hid bilan boğliq asosiy emotsional maylar keltirib çiqaradigan boşqa ovqatlaniş javoblariga deyarli ta’sir qilmaydi. Aksinça, lateral sohalarni olib taşlaş murakkabroq hid biliş şartli reflekslarini yöqotadi.

ch54-f76.text: Lateral hid biliş sohasi asosan _prepiriform_ va _piriform pöstloq_ hamda _bodomsimon yadrolarning pöstloq qismidan_ iborat. Bu sohalardan signal yöllari limbik tizimning deyarli barça qismlariga, ayniqsa gippokamp kabi kamroq primitiv qismlariga ötadi. Ular odamning muayyan ovqatlar bilan tajribasiga qarab ularni yoqtiriş yoki yoqtirmaslikni örganiş uçun eng muhim bölib körinadi. Masalan, bu lateral hid biliş sohasi va uning limbik xulq-atvor tizimi bilan köplab boğlanişlari odamda köngil aynişi va qusişga sabab bölgan ovqatlarga mutlaq jirkaniş rivojlanişiga sabab böladi, deb hisoblanadi.
ch54-f76.lead: Unçalik qadimiy bölmagan hid biliş tizimi — lateral hid biliş sohasi.

ch54-f77.text: Lateral hid biliş sohasining muhim xususiyati şundaki, bu sohadan köplab signal yöllari _çakka bölagining oldingi-medial qismidagi_ _paleokorteks_ deb ataluvçi _boş miya pöstloğining qadimiyroq qismiga_ ham bevosita boradi. Bu butun boş miya pöstloğida sezgi signallari avval talamusdan ötmasdan bevosita pöstloqqa ötadigan yagona sohadir.

ch54-f78.text: Talamus orqali ötib, talamusning dorsomedial yadrosiga, söngra orbitofrontal pöstloqning lateral-orqa kvadrantiga boradigan yangiroq hid biliş yöli topilgan. Maymunlarda ötkazilgan tadqiqotlar asosida bu yangiroq tizim ehtimol hidni ongli tahlil qilişga yordam beradi.

ch54-f79.text: Şunday qilib, asosiy hid biliş reflekslariga xizmat qiladigan _primitiv_ hid biliş tizimi, ovqat iste’molini va zaharli hamda zararli ovqatlardan jirkanişni avtomatik, ammo qisman örganilgan tarzda boşqaradigan _unçalik qadimiy bölmagan_ tizim va köpçilik boşqa pöstloq sezgi tizimlari bilan taqqoslaş mumkin bölgan, hidni ongli idrok etiş va tahlil qiliş uçun işlatiladigan _yangiroq_ tizim mavjud bölib körinadi.

ch54-f80.text: Miyaning hid biliş qismlaridan boşlanadigan köplab nerv tolalari miyadan taşqariga qarab hid biliş yöli orqali hid biliş piyozçasiga (ya’ni miyadan periferiyaga markazdan qoçma yönalişda) boradi. Bu nerv tolalari hid biliş piyozçasida mitral va popuksimon hujayralar orasida joylaşgan köp sonli mayda _donador hujayralarda_ tugaydi. Donador hujayralar mitral va popuksimon hujayralarga tormozlovçi signallar yuboradi. Bu tormozlovçi teskari aloqa odamning bir hidni boşqasidan farqlaşdagi öziga xos qobiliyatini ötkirlaştiriş vositasi bölişi mumkin.
ch54-f80.lead: Hid biliş piyozçasi faolligining markaziy nerv tizimi tomonidan markazdan qoçma boşqarilişi.
